name: Zankaja
summary: Zankaja is a young orc woman living in Orgrimmar, residing along the path between the Valley of Strength and the Valley of Wisdom. She anxiously awaits news of her mate, Dogran, who was assigned to duty at the Crossroads in the dangerous frontier of the Barrens.

sections.title: A Watchful Heart
sections.body: Life in the fledgling Horde capital is demanding, but for Zankaja, the true ordeal is the waiting. Her mate Dogran earned a promotion that sent him south into the Barrens to bolster the outpost at the Crossroads. While an honor for a warrior, the Barrens is a brutal expanse crawling with quilboar, centaur, and aggressive beasts. When Dogran failed to send word or return home as expected, Zankaja began seeking out travelers willing to seek news of his fate.

sections.title: Tragic Tidings
sections.body: Zankaja's worst fears prove warranted when inquiries in the Barrens uncover that Dogran fell into the clutches of the quilboar. Though she holds onto hope within Orgrimmar's canyon walls, the frontier is unforgiving, and the news brought back by adventurers paints a grim picture of sacrifice on the Horde's perilous borders.

faq.answer: Zankaja stands along the path connecting the Valley of Strength and the Valley of Wisdom in the city of Orgrimmar.
Dogran is Zankaja's mate. He is an orc warrior whose recent promotion earned him a station at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
Dogran was sent into the harsh wilds of the Barrens for his duties at the Crossroads and failed to return or send word home, leading Zankaja to fear he met harm along the frontier.

faq.q: What does Zankaja ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: She asks passing adventurers traveling out of Orgrimmar to visit Captain Gazrog at the Crossroads to inquire about Dogran's whereabouts and wellbeing.

faq.q: What happened to Dogran in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Dogran's whereabouts are uncertain to Zankaja. She asks travelers to speak with Gazrog at the Crossroads and follow the trail from there.

angles.text: Zankaja embodies the personal cost borne by ordinary families in Durotar, where duty to the Warchief's new realm regularly sends loved ones into untamed, lethal frontiers.
Her plea reminds Horde adventurers that holding outposts like the Crossroads requires real blood and sacrifice from the grunts stationed there.
